title: Eagle Point entities sell shares in Acres Commercial Realty worth nearly $241k - Investing.com
description: Eagle Point entities, including Eagle Point Credit Management LLC and Eagle Point DIF GP I LLC, have sold shares of ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. (ACR) worth nearly $241,000. The transactions involved the company's 8.625% Series C Preferred Stock, with the shares sold at prices ranging from $24.63 to $24.67.

title: Acres and LandLeader Forge Partnership to Advance Transparency & Expediency in Rural Land Transactions
description: Acres, a land intelligence platform, has partnered with LandLeader, a network of real estate professionals specializing in farm, ranch, and recreational properties. The partnership aims to provide LandLeader's clients with access to Acres' comprehensive data solutions, enabling informed and expedient decisions in the land transaction process.

title: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. Declares Quarterly Cash Dividends for its Preferred Stock
description: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. announced that its Board of Directors declared cash dividends on its Preferred Stock, including an 8.625% Fixed-to-Floating Series C Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock and a 7.875% Series D Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock.
